+import csv
+import io
+
+
+def read_records(text: str) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
+    """Read CSV records with normalized headers and trimmed cell values."""
+    if not text.strip():
+        return []
+
+    reader = csv.reader(io.StringIO(text, newline=""))
+    headers = [header.strip() for header in next(reader)]
+    if not headers or any(not header for header in headers):
+        raise ValueError("CSV headers must not be empty")
+    if len(set(headers)) != len(headers):
+        raise ValueError("CSV headers must be unique after trimming")
+
+    records = []
+    for row in reader:
+        if len(row) != len(headers):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"CSV row ending at line {reader.line_num} has {len(row)} "
+                f"cells; expected {len(headers)}"
+            )
+        records.append(dict(zip(headers, (cell.strip() for cell in row))))
+    return records
